title: Agent control output (.agent-hq/control.json)
description: A run's one outcome. `queue` declares what the ticket should do next (identity of each spawned run = <source-run-id>:<key>); `blocked` stops the ticket for a human. An empty `queue` is how a run says 'nothing further from me' -- there is no separate 'complete' outcome.

queue.description: Entries to add to the ticket's queue, in the order they should run. Empty means add nothing.

cancel.description: Keys of QUEUED entries to cancel. Omission never cancels: a run that simply does not mention a pending entry leaves it alone, so one branch of a fan-out cannot drop its sibling by saying nothing. A key matching no QUEUED entry is ignored; a key matching more than one is an error, since which was meant is unknowable.

cancel_pending.description: Cancel every QUEUED entry on the ticket before adding this document's own. The deliberate 'drop the plan and re-route' move -- recorded as one run.cancelled event per entry, so replacing a route is always visible in the ledger.

summary.description: Conventional-Commits summary of what this run changed in the work repo. First line becomes the landed commit's subject, the rest its body. Omitted by a run that changed no files.
